title: Roblox OG Sounds
blurb: Old Roblox had a very specific sonic fingerprint, and most of it has quietly been replaced. Here is a run through the classics, the oof death sound chief among them, which came originally from a 2000 game called Messiah and was pulled from Roblox in July 2022 when a licensing dispute with composer Tommy Tallarico could not be settled. Millions of children got their first copyright lesson that week. For anyone who played between roughly 2010 and 2020, these noises land somewhere between nostalgia and mild grief.
origin: A compilation of classic Roblox sound effects, including the retired oof death sound.
